extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, agents/attorneys, and patent examiners working on biotechnology applications (biological deposits, nucleotide/amino acid sequence disclosures, and sequence listings)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for meeting USPTO requirements for biotechnology patent applications, including biological-material deposit rules and nucleotide/amino-acid sequence listing (WIPO/ST.26 and ST.25) content and format requirements. Covers examination, amendments, publication, and cross-jurisdictional consequences.
